notes.upstream: * [Milestone](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/milestones/1.31.0) This is a security-oriented major release with several critical security patches. Our rolling-release channel (*edge*) is still recommended for faster security patches. Breaking change 💥: * Require PHP 8.2+ (drop PHP 8.1) * Replace bcrypt challenge auth with direct password comparison. We are dropping a custom client-side crypto that avoided transmitting the login password in plain-text, in favour of HTTPS. The custom crypto was a design choice made when HTTPS was rare for self-hosted solutions. But this had other problems and did not protect the session anyway. We will now simplify and rely on HTTPS only. Feature highlights✨: * Native HTML5 parsing (only if PHP 8.4+) as well as native img lazyload, for better compliance, security, and performance * User queries can define their own sorting criterion (field and direction) Security highlights 🛡: * Fix several critical vulnerabilities, both local and remote * Fix security exploits in search queries * Use HTTP header `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` * Use HTTP header `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` more generally * WebSub implement support for `hub.secret` * Docker images updated regarding the security of Apache, PHP, cURL Improved performance 🏎️: * SQL speed improvement for batch mark as read under SQLite and PostgreSQL Bug fixes highlights 🐛: * Fix HTTP Retry-After cache when proxy is used * Fix 32-bit systems * Fix API lookup of the localised default category * Etc.
